title: Assistant
description: Ask openJII about this page, your work, or the research library.

history.title: Threads
history.empty: Your assistant threads will appear here.

empty.title: What are you working on?
empty.description: Ask about the current page, your data, public work, the documentation, or the admitted literature corpus.

prompts.findProtocol: Find a protocol for PAR measurements
prompts.startExperiment: Help me start an experiment from a starter

pending.description: The model is deciding which permitted sources and tools it needs.

composer.label: Message the assistant
composer.placeholder: Ask about this page, your data, or the docs...

quota.title: Daily assistant budget
quota.exhaustedDescription: The assistant will answer again after the budget resets. Search and the documentation still work.

ASSISTANT_DISABLED.title: Assistant unavailable
ASSISTANT_DISABLED.description: Your account is not in the assistant cohort.

ASSISTANT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.title: Daily budget reached
ASSISTANT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.description: Try again after the daily budget resets.

PROVIDER_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.title: Selected model unavailable
PROVIDER_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.description: The selected model is not enabled for this workspace. Your question is saved in the composer. An administrator must configure model access before you can retry.

PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.title: Model unavailable
PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.description: The model provider could not be reached. Your question is still in the composer so you can retry.

TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.title: Turn budget reached
TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.description: The assistant could not fit another model request within this turn’s token allowance. Any prepared drafts remain subject to your confirmation. Check Usage before retrying.

TOOL_LOOP_LIMIT.title: Too many tool steps
TOOL_LOOP_LIMIT.description: The assistant stopped before it could finish. Narrow the question and try again.

UNKNOWN.title: The assistant could not answer
UNKNOWN.description: Check your connection and try again. No write was made.

draft.title: Draft {{type}}
draft.retryConfirmationHelp: Creation was interrupted. Retry to finish setup without creating another copy.
draft.actionError: This draft could not be changed. It may no longer be pending, or your access may have changed.

workspace.title: Assistant workspace
workspace.description: Browse reusable work, manage the sources the assistant may cite, and see usage without exposing prompt text.

error.title: Could not load this section
error.description: The server returned an error. Retry after checking the capability status.

starters.curatedDescription: Reviewed starting points from the Jan IngenHousz Institute.
starters.publicDescription: Public experiments, protocols, workbooks, and macros that can be copied into your organization.
starters.empty: No public work matches these filters.

copy.privateHint: The copy starts private. You can publish it later from its own page.
